turns.question: what is operating system explain in details
turns.answer: An operating system is software that enables applications to interact with a computer's hardware, separating applications from the hardware they access and providing services that allow each application to execute safely and effectively [1]. It is primarily a resource manager that manages hardware (processors, memory, input/output devices, communication devices) and software abstractions (processes, threads, files, databases) [1]. The core components of an operating system are contained in the kernel [1]. Operating systems are found in devices ranging from cell phones and automobiles to personal and mainframe computers [1]. They manage the software and hardware to produce the desired result when a user requests an action (e.g., execute an application or print a document) [1].
